# Recorded protocol fixtures

Captured from Droid CLI 1.4.1 on 2026-11-05 using only invented inputs in a
temporary repository. Session identifiers were replaced with synthetic IDs.
The result text, usage keys, and counts retain the observed wire format.
`permission-failure.json` came from a denied edit (process exit 1); the other
three came from the schema trials (process exit 0). No account data or real
repository content is included. See `docs/droid-capabilities.md`.
